parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: Cyclopentane reacts with $\text{Cl}_2$ in the presence of ultraviolet light to form $\text{C}_5\text{H}_9\text{Cl}$.
parts.text:
The reaction is initiated by the bond fission of $\text{Cl}_2$.

State the type of bond fission shown in the initiation step.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
Complete the equations to show the two propagation steps that follow the initiation step.

propagation 1 $$\text{C}_5\text{H}_{10} + \ldots\ldots \rightarrow \text{C}_5\text{H}_9\bullet + \ldots\ldots$$

propagation 2 $$\text{C}_5\text{H}_9\bullet + \ldots\ldots \rightarrow \ldots\ldots$$

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
The final step is shown.

$$\text{C}_5\text{H}_9\bullet + \text{Cl}\bullet \rightarrow \text{C}_5\text{H}_9\text{Cl}$$

Give the name for this step in the reaction.
